key:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
source:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
text:
Fanombohana haingana
1. Apetraho ny Torque Pro (ny kinova karamaina; tsy mahazaka plugins ny Torque Lite) ary ampiarahina ny adapter OBD-II-nao.
2. Alefaso ity plugin ity ao amin'ny Torque → Fikirana → Plugins.
3. Avelao ny fampahafantarana, ary apetraho ho Tsy voafetra ny fampiasana bateria mba hahafahan'ny Torque manomboka ity plugin ity any aoriana.
4. Ao amin'ny Torque, fidio ny mombamomba ny fiara ho an'ny fiara entinao. Tehirizina isaky ny mombamomba Torque ny angona ary ampitahaina amin'ny mombamomba VIN/ECU ny fiara.
5. Amin'ny mombamomba vaovao dia fantatra ny loharanon-tsolika rehefa mifandray ianao; raha anontaniana, ampitahao amin'ny famantarana eo amin'ny solaitrabe dia tsindrio Hamafiso. Ao amin'ny pejy fametrahana sy ao amin'ny fampahafantarana ny Hamafiso. Azonao fidina eto ambany koa.
6. Tsy misy haben'ny tanky hampidirina eto. Ny fanitsiana tsirairay mianatra ny azy, aseho eo ambanin'ny Haben'ny tanky nianarana; mandra-pahatongan'izany ny isan-jato voahitsy dia mamaky 1:1 miaraka amin'ny fandrefesana. Ampidiro ny haben'ny tanky ao amin'ny mombamomba fiara Torque ho an'ny solika sisa sy DTE an'ny Torque mihitsy.
7. Ao amin'ny Torque, ampio fandrefesana ho an'ny [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level ary, ho an'ny fanitsiana tsirairay, Corrected % sy Tank size. Tsy mamoaka solika sisa na DTE ilay plugin. Fampahafantarana mandritra ny fanitsiana indray no milaza fa mamaky 1:1 izany fanitsiana izany mandra-pahavitan'ny fanitsiana indray.
8. Avereno any amin'ny Torque ny haavon'ny solika: Vonoy, Malama, na Ahitsy avy amin'ny fanitsiana Chunk, Band na Kalman ho eo amin'ny fandrefesana 012F-nao. Ny solika sisa sy DTE an'ny Torque mihitsy dia mampiasa izany haavo izany miaraka amin'ny haben'ny tanky sy ny mpg maharitra ao amin'ny mombamomba Torque.
9. Ny solika ihany no isaina rehefa mandeha ny motera. Ny plugin ihany no mandeha rehefa mifandray amin'ny ECU ny Torque.
10. Tohizo ny fitondrana sy ny famenoana; mihatsara ny fahamarinana amin'ny tanky tsy feno maromaro. Raha tsy afaka milaza ny plugin hoe fiara inona ity, manontany amin'ny fampahafantarana sy amin'ity pejy ity izy; fidio izay hatao amin'izany dia izany.
11. Mijanona amin'ity finday ity ny angona rehetra. Tsy misy GPS na toerana voarakitra.
